good.last_message: No. The worst case gives 0.00 mm against the 0.10 mm minimum, so REQ-MECH-007 fails worst case (RSS 0.19 to 0.61 mm would pass, but RSS is not the requirement). Tighten the J4 connector height from ±0.15 to ±0.05 mm, which lifts the worst-case minimum to 0.10 mm.
